items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: Louie Cole was a member of the Blackbirds and stayed, and Peter du Conge, naturally.

ctx.x: Yeh. And Louie Cole. Louie Cole was a member of the Blackbirds and stayed, and Peter du Conge, naturally.
And was du Conge the leader of the band, or --
No, Nelson Kincaide was the leader.
